\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 202-205 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R209-first-pass-words-from-chapters-202-205}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a lamp and bread.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a cave, a palace, a fort, a tower, a garden
  \item a zoo, a museum, a tunnel, a bicycle, a scooter
  \item a lorry, a rickshaw, an aeroplane, petrol, a telephone
  \item a letter, an envelope, a ticket office, a message, a conversation
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A cave? (\textbf{\hi{गुफ़ा}}, \emph{gufā}.) A palace? (\textbf{\hi{महल}}, \emph{mahal}.) A fort? (\textbf{\hi{क़िला}}, \emph{qilā}.) A tower? (\textbf{\hi{मीनार}}, \emph{mīnār}.) A garden? (\textbf{\hi{बाग़}}, \emph{bāg}.) A zoo? (\textbf{\hi{चिड़ियाघर}}, \emph{ciṛiyāghar}.) A museum? (\textbf{\hi{संग्रहालय}}, \emph{saṅgrahālay}.) A tunnel? (\textbf{\hi{सुरंग}}, \emph{suraṅg}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\hi{साइकिल}}, \emph{sāikil}.) A scooter? (\textbf{\hi{स्कूटर}}, \emph{skūṭar}.) A lorry? (\textbf{\hi{ट्रक}}, \emph{ṭrak}.) A rickshaw? (\textbf{\hi{रिक्शा}}, \emph{rikśā}.) An aeroplane? (\textbf{\hi{हवाई} \hi{जहाज़}}, \emph{havāī jahāz}.) Petrol? (\textbf{\hi{पेट्रोल}}, \emph{peṭrol}.) A telephone? (\textbf{\hi{फ़ोन}}, \emph{phon}.) A letter? (\textbf{\hi{पत्र}}, \emph{patra}.) An envelope? (\textbf{\hi{लिफ़ाफ़ा}}, \emph{lifāfā}.) A ticket office? (\textbf{\hi{टिकट} \hi{घर}}, \emph{ṭikaṭ ghar}.) A message? (\textbf{\hi{संदेसा}}, \emph{sandesā}.) A conversation? (\textbf{\hi{बातचीत}}, \emph{bātcīt}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 206-209 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R209-second-pass-words-from-chapters-206-209}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for advice and an opinion.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item advice, an opinion, a thought, a lie, a promise
  \item a condition, a debt, earnings, savings, expense
  \item a loss, a benefit, a price, a coin, a banknote
  \item a balcony, a cup, a needle, a lamp, bread
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Advice? (\textbf{\hi{सलाह}}, \emph{salāh}.) An opinion? (\textbf{\hi{राय}}, \emph{rāy}.) A thought? (\textbf{\hi{विचार}}, \emph{vicār}.) A lie? (\textbf{\hi{झूठ}}, \emph{jhūṭh}.) A promise? (\textbf{\hi{वादा}}, \emph{vādā}.) A condition? (\textbf{\hi{शर्त}}, \emph{śart}.) A debt? (\textbf{\hi{क़र्ज़}}, \emph{qarz}.) Earnings? (\textbf{\hi{कमाई}}, \emph{kamāī}.) Savings? (\textbf{\hi{बचत}}, \emph{bacat}.) Expense? (\textbf{\hi{ख़र्च}}, \emph{kharc}.) A loss? (\textbf{\hi{नुक़सान}}, \emph{nuqsān}.) A benefit? (\textbf{\hi{फ़ायदा}}, \emph{fāydā}.) A price? (\textbf{\hi{क़ीमत}}, \emph{kīmat}.) A coin? (\textbf{\hi{सिक्का}}, \emph{sikkā}.) A banknote? (\textbf{\hi{नोट}}, \emph{noṭ}.) A balcony? (\textbf{\hi{छज्जा}}, \emph{chajjā}.) A cup? (\textbf{\hi{प्याला}}, \emph{pyālā}.) A needle? (\textbf{\hi{सुई}}, \emph{suī}.) A lamp? (\textbf{\hi{बत्ती}}, \emph{battī}.) Bread? (\textbf{\hi{रोटी}}, \emph{roṭī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
